lines.t: I left the city in the rearview mirror today
Chasing a feeling that the wind blew my way
I’ve been sleeping in the backseat, dreaming of the coast
Trying to find the version of me I love the most
And the mountains are rising like a prayer in the sky
I’m finally seeing through a brand new set of eyes.
[Pre-Chorus]
(Guitar builds, picking up speed)
Oh, I can feel the rhythm of a heart untied
There’s a wilder kind of life waiting on the inside.
So let the sunlight break, let the world open wide
I’m leaving every heavy shadow behind!
It’s a long way up but I’m on the right track
I’ve got the Truth in my soul and the wind at my back
Hallelujah, I ain’t looking back!
I found a map in the pages of a book I used to hide
It’s been a compass in the dark, it’s been a steady guide
Now the air is getting colder but the fire’s getting bright
I’m walking through the woods to the edge of the light
Yeah, the road might be narrow and the climb might be steep
But I’ve got a promise that I’m gonna keep.
I was running! (I was running!)
Now I’m standing! (Now I’m standing!)
On the edge of a brand new beginning!
Yeah, the Stone! (The Stone!)
Is rolled away!
I’m breathing in the life of a brand new day!
So let the sunlight break, let the world open wide
I’m leaving every heavy shadow behind!
It’s a long way up but I’m on the right track
I’ve got the Truth in my soul and the wind at my back
Hallelujah, I ain’t looking back!
So let the sunlight break, let the world open wide
I’m leaving every heavy shadow behind!
It’s a long way up but I’m on the right track
I’ve got the Truth in my soul and the wind at my back
Hallelujah, I ain’t looking back!
Just a long road home...
Yeah, I’m finally home.
